stdout:
1. IMPRESSION: A refreshingly evidence-first pitch — live deployed demo, public CI with coverage, reality-gated capability chips, and honest gap disclosure — but the evidence chain stops exactly where the ML/NER claims begin.

2. BIGGEST GAP: A product whose whole thesis is "cited or it didn't happen" publishes no evaluation numbers of its own — no NER precision/recall/F1, no wrong-citation rate, no latency or cost — so the core ML quality claim is itself uncited.

3. HIRE: Conditional yes — engage once he publishes NER precision/recall/F1 and a wrong-citation rate measured on real held-out data and lights up at least one server-AI tier plus one sync pipeline end-to-end, because that is days of work for a genuine specialist and will either materialize fast or expose the vaporware.
